title: Criteria-Governed Decision-Making in Sparse Seismic Networks: Evidence Sufficiency, Non-Confirmation Reliability, and Analyst Escalation (code, decision records and results)
description: Code, per-episode decision records, results and provenance for the manuscript «Criteria-Governed Decision-Making in Sparse Seismic Networks: Evidence Sufficiency, Non-Confirmation Reliability, and Analyst Escalation» (S. Zhakypbekov, A. Bykov, A. Shaikemelova, T. Chinibayeva; in preparation for MDPI Sensors). Pre-registered tests on 38 seismic networks in eight regions (incl. Kazakhstan, Kyrgyzstan, Alaska) against catalogue association and analyst-reviewed bulletins; test plans registered on OSF: https://osf.io/y8qxz.
